text_block_list.text:
One day, Бива Хаяхидэ and Narita
Taishin are
training hard together.
Phew... There, that makes three sets.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Huh, you been doing more reps or
something?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
No, I don't think so. It's the same as
always...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The last time we worked out together,
we only
ran three laps. Now you're
asking to go for a
fourth. Pretty sure
four's more than three.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. Your confusion must derive
from my
description of this workout
being "the same as
always."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Lately, my trainer and I have been
customizing
workouts based on the
condition of my body and
the track
instead of depending on set numbers.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Since it's sunny and I feel great today,
we
determined that increasing my reps
by thirty
percent would more evenly
distribute my
workload over the course
of the week and—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ugh, enough. I get it. You can stop now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You're telling me your trainer has to put
up with
this all the time?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say there's any "putting up
with" me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
My trainer always takes the time to
understand
what I'm saying and lets me
know if something is a
good or bad idea.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I value our relationship... very much.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Tell me about your little crush later. Let's get to work.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I-I do not have a crush! How dare you
twist my
words when I was talking about
something of
importance!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
...It's true that Бива Хаяхидэ really has
grown so
much. Even her friends are
picking up on it!
